mechanisms.mechanism: AX stable refs / changes-after-settle / optimized discovery
mechanisms.reason: 本地有 fresh host AX 查询与 wait/query 选择，但没有同样的跨快照短ref协议。上游反例显示可编辑值、ID复用与相同树无法证明记录身份；frame counter稳定亦不是目标身份或业务成功。优化discovery软叶/跳格预算可能漏元素；settle超时不取消挂起read。尚无本地当前承诺回归，需先定义有代际/新鲜度的引用契约。
mechanisms.benefit: 未来减少 agent 重读整树的token与定位成本；性能数字均为上游自述未本地验证。
bdd_if_adopt: Given ref绑定目标/会话/快照代际，When 目标、页面、几何或语义身份改变 Then stale/unknown且不派发
Given 重复标签、value-only编辑行、复用ID或屏幕替换 When再定位 Then 不把坐标匹配当身份验证
Given AX读取挂起或预算耗尽 Then deadline有界且结果partial/unknown，不报告settled完整
Given tap已派发而后续验证超时 Then 保留executed/unknown且不自动重放

new target/session/snapshot-bound ref models and fixture tests

mechanisms.mechanism: HID delivery ACK / Device Hub shadow / no replay
mechanisms.reason: 当前main内置DTUHID及legacy guard对unknown拒绝，错误/派发/业务确认分离且禁止自动重放，已覆盖本地同类安全要求。上游首次shadow探测unknown仍放行，4s ACK超时仍exit0，旧server/addon兼容把undefined作为成功，不能作为更强保证。并非宣称Triton实现了上游所有按钮/WS协议。
上游专用direct actor/toolbar路径；本地没有同样持久Node入口。弃置不可取消direct调用后仍fallback，完成不等于业务成功；home flick需chrome/orientation/shadow确认。不能引入在派发unknown后重放策略。
main device clipboard已有64KiB、退出/截断拒绝、前后读取与verified分离，明确staging不是输入或App接受。上游256KiB devicectl逐字节读回及Cmd+V为额外实现选择；本地使用Swift String相等，不声称逐字节等价。没有当前本地故障证据，不自动切换devicectl或增加浏览器paste控制面。
上游为持久Node会话追踪modifier与拆连接的软件键盘策略；本地没有相同handle/session丢失回归。保存boot mtime状态和AX键盘外观是启发式，不能升级为权威键盘身份/状态。
Triton现有app生命周期不承诺Metro发现/广播。上游多peer广播仅靠/json/list与role ios猜测陈旧socket，明确可能影响未出现在inspector的iOS真机；不把此广播用于目标隔离。
完整四核心/bin/build与53个测试源及fixtures已读；two-phase accepted/go防重复、私有socket/worker隔离可参考，但实际收益针对Node bundle编译，未证实Swift CLI存在相同瓶颈。环境标记不是内核sandbox鉴权，mtime不是制品身份；不引入常驻进程/全环境转发。

mechanisms.local_gap: fixed main validates sim.record sample duration and device recording session identity, but those inspected contracts do not emit sample/event sidecars or offline sample/diff inspection; no matching mechanism found by targeted git grep
mechanisms.benefit: agent can locate before/after frames in existing recordings without a viewer or continuous collection
mechanisms.source_boundary: index changed means surface identity/seed or captured sequence, not semantic UI success; event-near-frame is correlation, not causation; constant wall-minus-uptime join can drift after wall clock change
bdd: Given a finished local recording, when inspecting an exact sample then return actual decoded PTS, dimension, artifact SHA and preserve source identity; stale sidecar/PTS mismatch must fail
Given a truncated/malformed/duplicate footer or mismatched declared counts then completeness is partial/error, never footer-present alone
Given two frames with mismatched geometry then fail explicitly; pixel threshold/maxDelta are reported and never prove action success
candidate_files: new offline recording inspection runtime/models and fixture tests
mechanisms.dispatch_reason: Keep as candidate: source review complete, but a concrete local diagnostic requirement and final CLI contract/identity-budget design should be selected before broad new recording/index commands. No existing main bug demonstrated.

mechanisms.reason: adds continuous collection surface and memory/privacy lifecycle; not a concrete current main defect. Upstream defaults off and isolates sampler, but maxBytes is not a strict bound for the newest oversize frame and newest stale sample is retained indefinitely; stop discards inflight result and unsubscribes
bdd_if_future_adopt: Byte/time/count budgets are strict including one oversized frame; expired latest frame carries stale/unknown
Stop/restart invalidates old inflight capture; each view binds target/session/geometry

mechanisms.benefit: 未来覆盖 expo-camera/VisionCamera 的录制与 remount 场景，避免记录状态和输出文件成功语义不一致。
bdd: Given opt-in bundle with supported fake session and MovieFileOutput, when start then stop, then return exactly one completion and a playable video-only file with accurate duration/size.
Given existing destination or stopped session, when record requested, then fail explicitly without replacing/writing a file.
Given writer failure or output removal/session release, then bounded completion preserves success/error distinction and releases owned objects.
Given an output moved to another session, when the old session tears down, then it cannot stop the new owner recording.
Given unsupported native graph or codec, then report unsupported/unknown and do not imply native AVFoundation feature parity.
